title: IG site publish template: remote mounts and FHIR packages
location: ig-site-mount-v1-<hash>, in each IG repository that copies templates/ig-repo-site/site-publish.yml
derivedInputs: the IG repository's index.lock.json and sushi-config.yaml
producer: the IG repository's site-publish job (from this template), any run that misses the key
consumers: the same job's mount step and the site build's FHIR package reads

stateInputs.how: not yet derived from a recorded read set; the producer may read state:mount graphs

savePolicy: any run that misses the key
verify: the mount half is checked by mount-from-lock against the lock; the FHIR packages are used as found (versioned by name)
notes: A template: each IG repository holds its own copy, so a change here reaches an IG only when it re-copies the template. Its mount half is superseded by `layers-ref` like `fhir-cat-mount`; what stays is the FHIR package cache, which could become its own node keyed by sushi-config.yaml alone.
